nodes.text: Enter Brackenhide Hollow on Normal; the follower-dungeon option is supported if offered by your character’s Group Finder.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Free the marked Captive Tuskarr in the opening shore area, clearing each cage’s guards. Stay in this same instance visit for the full rescue.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Defeat Hackclaw’s War-Band to open the gate. Interrupt Greater Healing Rapids and handle Gashtooth’s disabling attacks with your group/followers.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Near the bridge toward Gutshot, search the riverbank cave for a single captive. Check Rageclaw’s pen for another: kill its guards and bear before opening that cage.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Follow the dungeon route to Treemouth and defeat him to open the route. From his area, follow the lower river until it forks; the concealed cave in the ravine holds three more captives. Check the cave beyond the obvious decoy opening.

recovery.text: Avoid the continuously respawning hyena/slime caves. If followers stick outside, bring them back to the entrance. Cage placement can vary; rely on the live all-captives criterion, not a manually tallied group of seven.

nodes.text: Check the final cage by the gnoll and large slime before Gutshot’s bridge. Free every remaining captive until The Vegetarian Diet is actually awarded; do not reset the instance mid-rescue.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Collect the thank-you mail from Bertinaut, Sentiu and Japukitat and take Happy Tuskarr Palooza from the letter.

recovery.text: The reward is mailed. If the achievement did not complete, recheck the guarded side cages during the same visit; a guessed total or freeing only the marked coast cages is insufficient.

nodes.text: Use Happy Tuskarr Palooza from your bags to learn the toy.

recovery.text: Only Toy Box ownership finishes this goal. Loot, mail, an achievement and the guide cursor remain separate evidence.
